canonical_project: Alterations and Additions to Existing Data Centre, 3 Brookhollow Avenue Norwest
notes: Sydney Central City Planning Panel DA 1382/2025/JP for 3 Brookhollow Avenue, Norwest was approved on 2025-09-04 with capital investment value of A$84.7m. Sydney Development Journal describes this as Stage 1 upgrades raising the existing centre from 4 MW to 14.9 MW.
